text:
Alex Chen: Heads-up: starting deploy for v2.3.1 now. Primary change is feature flag `llm-route-v2` slow-start with metric gate. Change window 23:00-02:00 UTC. @ops-oncall @Maria Gomez please ack. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/v2.3.1 :eyes:

deploy-bot: Deploy started — deploy_id=deploy-20240228-72. Targets: inference-router, route-allocator. Planned flag transitions: llm-route-v2 => staged. To pin/unpin quickly run the deploy tool or `rdw pin` (see runbook).

Samira Patel: Quick Q — what exactly is the metric gate for this rollout? p50/p95/p99 thresholds? I can hook dashboards.

Maria Gomez: Metric gate = p99 latency delta + error-rate floor. Concrete rules: fail if error_rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m OR p99 increases by >200ms sustained in 3/5 evaluation windows. Ramp plan: 1% traffic for 10m, 5% for 15m, 20% for 20m, then 50% then cutover if all gates pass. If gate trips, we rollback to pinned version immediately.

Alex Chen: I'm pinning current route to version `llm-route-v1-20240220` so rollback is fast. Will update the pin in the deploy tool.

ops-oncall: Ack. I'll watch SLOs and have runway to rollback. Runbook snippet here for quick rollback:
```
curl -X POST https://deploybot.internal/api/v1/rollback 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"deploy_id":"deploy-20240228-72"}'
```
Use that if p99 > baseline + 250ms or error spikes above threshold.

Samira Patel: I'll add a temporary alert: `ALERT if sum(rate(http_request_errors[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests[5m])) > 0.005` for route=router-main. Also adding a small log-sampling flag for first 1% to capture errors.

deploy-bot: Canary action: llm-route-v2 -> cohort=canary-1 @ 1% at 1708501290. Status: in-progress. Logs: https://ci.redwood/builds/deploy-20240228-72

Maria Gomez: Two operational notes: 1) watch token cost metrics (per-token changed slightly with the new path) — linked in release notes. 2) if we need to force-pin run: `rdw rollout --pin llm-route-v1-20240220 --deploy deploy-20240228-72` for instant revert.

Alex Chen: :thumbsup: thanks all. I'll post updates at each step (1% -> 5% -> 20%). If anything weird happens I'll call the rollback. @here

ops-oncall: Monitoring and notifications configured: Grafana dashboard https://grafana.redwood/d/route-llm/llm-route-overview. Slack alert set to this channel for metric-gate trips.

deploy-bot: Canary at 1% rolled successfully. Waiting on metric gate windows (next check in ~8m).
